Message.Name: Order Cancellation Market/Member Message
Message.Description: Used by the Server to communicate information order cancellation. The same message is used in Full-Depth data feeds (for order cancellations of any user), in the Order Entry Server (for cancellations of user orders) and in the Market & Order Server (for order cancellations of any user)

Field.Name: TransactionDateAndTime
Field.Description: Transaction Date and Time in nanoseconds since 1-jan-1970 UTC

Field.Name: EntryDate
Field.Description: System order entry date (when System Order Number was assigned)

Message.Name: Quote Cancellation Market/Member Message
Message.Description: Used by the Server to communicate information about quote cancellation. The same message is used in Full-Depth data feeds (for quote cancellations of any user), in the Order Entry Server (for cancellations of user quotes) and in the Market & Order Server (for quote cancellations of any user)

Field.Name: TransactionDateAndTime
Field.Description: Transaction Date and Time in nanoseconds since 1-jan-1970 UTC
